    rear = rig.get('trailer_rear', [-6.3, 0.0])

    steer = max(-32.0, min(32.0, 1.15*h))

        center = 0.5*(lo+hi)

        steer += max(-12.0, min(12.0, -2.0*(rear[1]-center)))

    speed = -0.65 if abs(h) < 28.0 else -0.35
    if obs.get('status') in ('JACKKNIFED', 'PINNED'):
        return (0.0, 0.0, look)
    return (steer, speed, look)
